title: Disney's THE LION KING – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: Disney's THE LION KING at Hammons Hall, Springfield MO
description: Disney's THE LION KING is a Tony Award-winning Broadway musical, directed by Julie Taymor, with music by Elton John and Tim Rice, and you attend by watching the stage show. It is recommended for ages 6+, and all patrons, regardless of age, must have a ticket. It runs from Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 7:30 PM through Saturday, December 12, 2026 at 2:00 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
